title: AgentDFIR Cross-Case Activity Graph
description: The `graph` member of `agentdfir correlate-cases --graph --json` (agentdfir.crosscase-graph/1). Entities stay in their own case: a node belongs to exactly one case, and a join edge between nodes of two cases names the identifier that ties them, the evidence on each side, a confidence grade with its reason, and how the two sides sit in time. Context edges place an entity inside its own case (case -> host -> execution environment -> session -> agent / entity) and carry no join_key. Weak joins never justify a finding. Node kinds, edge kinds and join keys are open sets: a consumer MUST accept values it does not know. Output order is deterministic.

includes_unverified_cases.description: True when a case whose seal did not verify was included with --allow-unverified.

host.description: Host name from the case manifest. Not a unique machine identifier.

max_edges_per_join.description: Edges of one join key type per pair of cases.

truncated.description: True when a bound left nodes or edges out. No edge ever points at a dropped node.

omitted.description: What a bound left out, by kind (nodes, edges, edges_<join_key>, identifiers_over_bound, unusable_identifiers, remote_launches).

caveats.description: What the graph can and cannot say, in plain sentences.

id.description: <kind>:<case label>:<key>; keys pass through credential masking.

kind.description: case | host | exec_env | agent_session | agent | mcp_tool | cloud_principal | cloud_resource | git_commit | file | destination (open set). File keys are sha256:<hex> (content) or name:<basename> (name only).

sideRef.description: Evidence for one side of an edge: the case and the sealed source of the event or collected artifact.

source_json_path.description: RFC 6901 pointer inside the source artifact, for one-line JSON documents.

kind.description: Join edges: same_session, same_agent, delegated_to, launched, same_tool_call, same_commit, same_content, same_principal_resource, same_principal, same_exec_env, same_destination, same_filename, similar_prompt. Context edges: collected_from, hosts, ran, contains, called, acted_as, acted_on, named_commit, named_destination, named_file, collected (open set).

join_key.description: Join key type; absent on context edges. strong: session_id, agent_id, delegation_ref, tool_call_id, session_id_in_command, git_commit, file_sha256, principal_resource. moderate: principal, exec_env. weak: destination, filename, prompt_similarity, git_commit_abbreviated, launch_timing. A strong join whose timestamps contradict its direction, or whose two recordings overlap, is downgraded to moderate.

join_value.description: The identifier, after credential masking. For prompt_similarity only the score; prompt text is never written.

relation.description: How the from side's recorded activity sits against the to side's.

from_time.description: First recorded time on the from side.

to_time.description: First recorded time on the to side.

evidence.description: One entry per side: two on a join edge, one on a context edge.

finding.description: A finding that exists only across cases. Carries the finding.schema.json fields (rule_id, severity, title, description, evidence_refs prefixed with the case label, corroboration status, confidence, mitre_atlas, mitre_attack, false_positive_notes, chain_steps) plus the fields below.
